applies_why: The judge text decides a [CR2] versus [DR3] collision by noting that the sign itself does not state the mechanism, so it is doing the chain-collision assessment the rule governs.
quote: the sign itself does not state the mechanism.
rule_words: When the witnesses pressed against a link are the pressing side's own chain read together, the collision weighs chain against chain by footing, never verse by verse; that no one of them states the contrary in its own words is the stating-verse test DG-61 retires, at a judge's seat as at a debater's, for either side.
room: by footing, never verse by verse — I weighed reading 1, that the judge must compare the pressed chains by exhibited support, against reading 2, that the judge may mark the link underdetermined because one sign verse does not itself state the mechanism.
why: The judge calls D3/C6 underdetermined because the sign itself omits the mechanism, which rests on verse-level statement rather than chain-against-chain footing.
